scripts.prestart: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('../shared')) { fs.rmSync('src/shared', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.cpSync('../shared', 'src/shared', { recursive: true }); console.log('Synchronized shared/ to src/shared/'); }"
scripts.prebuild: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('../shared')) { fs.rmSync('src/shared', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.cpSync('../shared', 'src/shared', { recursive: true }); console.log('Synchronized shared/ to src/shared/'); }"
